summary: Verifies and hardens Permission Broker compatibility after 108A/108B/108C without wiring the broker into execution, shell, commit, push, backend, adapter, Telegram, CI, or PR automation paths. Adds no new broker behavior; this phase's task contract deliberately excludes the core zone, structurally enforcing that src/pcae/core/permission_broker_foundation.py was not touched. Strengthens the test surface: broker import allowlist re-verified via AST; new direct confirmation that commit.py/push.py/task.py/phase.py/cli.py contain no reference at all to permission_broker_foundation or PermissionBroker( -- the broker remains completely unwired from every real command path, now permanently testable. Cross-references the broker's NG-/INV- outputs directly against the actual current text of docs/V0_2_EXECUTION_READINESS_NO_GO_GATES.md and docs/V0_2_AUTONOMY_CONTRACT.md rather than only against hardcoded expected sets. Re-verifies decision composition against the real 12-rule default registry, and re-confirms every fail-closed path resolves only to DENY or HUMAN_REVIEW, never ALLOW. 108A (60 tests), 108B (63 tests), and 108C (48 tests) all remain unmodified and pass unchanged. Added docs/PHASE_108_PERMISSION_BROKER_VERIFICATION_COMPATIBILITY.md. 44 new tests. Focused broker group (480), governance/autonomy group (1054), and release/lifecycle regression group (1458) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). No group required a sequential fallback. Follows a read-only repository protection inspection performed immediately beforehand.

No emergency stop implementation. No execution enablement. No execution availability toggle. No no-go runtime enforcement. No automatic apply. No patch execution. No PR creation. No PR merge. No approval automation. No required CI status-check changes. No branch protection changes. No hook auto-install. No pre-push hook. No production code in src/pcae/ changed -- verification tests and documentation only. No command-path integration: commit.py, push.py, task.py, phase.py, and cli.py confirmed to contain zero references to the broker. implementation_status remains unconditionally execution_unavailable on every decision. ALLOW never results in executable behavior. v0.1.0-rc1 remains non-executing by design. v0.2 remains the autonomy target (Level 3, not Level 4/5).
